architecture.mechanism: Acoustic analysis of vehicle sounds to determine location/vector of other vehicles, used to automatically configure the instrument display to indicate that location to the operator.
architecture.intervention: Mount acoustic sensors on the 2021 Subaru Outback and route the captured audio stream into a diagnostic module that, on detecting characteristic signatures of a battery thermal runaway event (cell venting, electrolyte boiling, casing crackle) or alternator/belt failure, automatically switches the instrument panel to a battery/charging alert state and triggers a controlled power-reduced mode before stalling occurs.
architecture.expected_effect: Early detection of battery thermal failure precursors allows the vehicle to warn the driver and shed non-essential loads, preventing the stalling and instrument-panel blackout observed at the traffic light.
architecture.falsification_test: On a dynamometer, induce controlled battery thermal runaway in a 2021 Outback and a known-failing-alternator unit while recording audio; verify that the acoustic-detection module flags the event and reconfigures the instrument display to the alert state at least 10 seconds before the engine stalls and panel power is lost; repeat across 30 trials to confirm sensitivity/specificity above 90%.
